source_refs.note: Topic printed 1.1.1.1 Maintenance (PDF 10, printed 7); numbering slip.

blocks.text: The final phase involves ongoing maintenance and updates. This ensures the software continues to function correctly and adapts to any changes in user needs or technology.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Maintenance is like taking care of a plant. You need to water it regularly and address any problems to keep it healthy and growing.
